title: Generation manifest
description: What a generation produced, and the lock on where it goes. specs/0004 R30 records the knowledge object, the artifact class, the target path, a content hash, and the pack version for each produced artifact. R31 reads the path on every later run and never decides it again. R32 makes moving a produced file an explicit recorded unlock — without it a relocation appears in a diff as a deletion and an addition, indistinguishable from a change in knowledge. R33 is the constraint that keeps it honest: the manifest records execution and decides nothing. R50 makes it committed, and rejects any design where placement is decided after the first run — specs/0002 R4 excludes placement from the knowledge base and R31 has nothing to read without it. specs/0008 R15 keeps it distinct from the distribution manifest: what is installed here and where a generation put things are different questions.

framework_version.description: specs/0004 R4 names four pinned identities a reproducibility claim must carry; this is where the manifest records the framework it was produced under.

artifacts.description: One entry per produced artifact. Empty on a run that produced nothing, which R53 relies on: a run ending without an artifact locks no path for it.

pack_version.description: Per artifact rather than only at the top: a repository generated across two pack versions has artifacts from each, and R35 attributing a difference needs to know which.

unlocked_from.description: specs/0004 R32: the path this artifact was moved from, recorded so a relocation is an explicit unlock rather than a deletion and an addition in a diff.
